Priya has two options. Option one is opening a second branch in a growing town 12 kilometres away; the plan forecasts it could add $190,000 in annual revenue, but the lease costs $3,000 per month. Way 2: The plan evidences her track record of $290,000 revenue from 7 gardeners [k], proving she is a credible borrower despite no formal training [app], increasing lender confidence [an].

questions.question_text: Do you think Sofia should hire the full-time designer rather than use a freelance designer? Justify your answer.
questions.model_answer: Hiring a full-time designer at $38,000 a year gives Sofia a dedicated expert to build premium design-and-build packages [k], strengthening her brand and attracting higher-value clients beyond maintenance work [app], which could lift revenue above $290,000 and support growth [an]. The freelance option at 10% of each fee is cheaper and more flexible [k], keeping fixed costs low while retained profit is only $22,000 and the bank has rejected her loan [app], but the freelancer may not prioritise her projects [an]. Overall, the freelance route is the wiser choice now because fixed costs of $38,000 would exceed her cash buffer [eval], with full-time hiring justified once design revenue is proven [eval].
